admission.justification: Prevents a retry borrowing foreign-provider permission choices or selecting an unconfigured stronger execution.

applicability: Role starts with a user-configured single step-up alternative, selected by failed-review threshold or a reasoned explicit request.
conditions: Worker counts failing recorded code rounds and Curator and Consolidator count failing recorded memory rounds; record-only checks add no try and other roles are on-request.

Validate the selected provider, model, effort and permitted features against known host offerings before retirement. Effort and feature inheritance retain their existing provider and model boundaries.
Explicit same-start agent/model/effort retain fieldwise precedence.

The selected step-up row supplies the mode for its effective harness. Its effective harness is the harness named in the step-up row, or the role defaults’ harness if the step-up row omits a harness. The step-up does not inherit the base role’s mode, including when the provider and model agree.

The shared launch resolver gives an explicit dashboard mode precedence. Otherwise the selected step-up row’s mode applies when the final launch harness matches the row’s effective harness and its authored provider binding allows the choice. If neither mode applies, the resolver uses the host-advertised default only when modes are known and the host advertises a default. With no resulting mode, the create request omits modeId.
exclusions: MCP role_start and role_start_set accept no explicit mode. Permission-bearing feature overrides still require authorized settings.
No automatic step-up with absent/unknown counts or absent configuration, no nested alternative and no reset of review allowance.
statement: The product selects user-authored step-up choices from persisted failed-review counts or an explicit reason while explicit same-start agent, model and effort overrides retain fieldwise precedence.
